lines.text: Paul says an overseer must be the husband of but one wife, gentle, and free of the love of money.
An overseer must manage his own household well, since otherwise he cannot care for the church of God.
An overseer must not be a recent convert, or he may become discouraged and fall under the condemnation of the devil.
Deacons must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience, and they must first be elected.
Paul writes so Timothy will know how to conduct himself in God's household, which is the church of the living God.
